mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, rule_key, enabled, config_json, last_run_at, last_status, updated_by, updated_at FROM workspace_automation WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY rule_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_automation (workspace_id, rule_key, enabled, config_json, updated_by) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{ruleKey}, #{enabled}, #{configJson}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), config_json = COALESCE(VALUES(config_json), config_json), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO workspace_automation (workspace_id, rule_key, enabled, last_run_at, last_status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{ruleKey}, 1, NOW(), #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_run_at = NOW(), last_status = VALUES(last_status)
